flows.name: Serverless web API
flows.explain: DNS sends visitors to the edge, which forwards API calls to API Gateway. API Gateway invokes a function, and the function reads and writes a table.

flows.name: Static website
flows.explain: A website's files live in an S3 bucket, and CloudFront caches them close to visitors.

flows.name: Signed-in API
flows.explain: Users sign in with Cognito; API Gateway checks their token before calling the backend.

flows.name: Event-driven upload processing
flows.explain: Once EventBridge is turned on for the bucket, each new object raises an event. A rule routes it to a function that queues follow-up work.

flows.name: Data lake analytics
flows.explain: Glue catalogues the files in S3 so Athena can query them with SQL where they lie.

flows.name: Generative AI app
flows.explain: An API calls a function that asks a foundation model on Bedrock and returns the answer.

flows.name: Container service
flows.explain: DNS points at a load balancer that spreads requests across the tasks of an ECS service on Fargate. The tasks keep their data in a managed RDS database.
